fact: The House Committee on National Planning and Economic Development held a public hearing on the Statistics Bill, 2025 (HB. 2491), which would repeal the 2007 Act; the Guardian reports it had passed first and second readings in July and December 2025.
The Guardian describes the 2007 Statistics Act as the current Act, enacted 18 years earlier and still in place until the Bill repeals it.
NALTF reports the House of Representatives passed the Statistics Bill, 2025 (HB.2491) at third reading on 10 December 2025, a bill to repeal the Statistics Act No. 9 of 2007.
NALTF refers to the existing Statistics Act, No. 9, 2007, which the Bill would repeal.

This document is the text of the Statistics Act, 2007 (Act No. 9), published in Official Gazette No. 60 of 11 June 2007; it establishes the National Statistical System and the National Bureau of Statistics.
